## User-visible change

Describe what a user or fresh AI session experiences differently.

## Recovery evidence

- [ ] Canonical and host skill trees are byte-identical.
- [ ] All skill directories and plugin manifests validate.
- [ ] The installed plugin was exercised from a fresh prompt.
- [ ] English and Chinese documentation agree, or this change has no documentation impact.
- [ ] Examples and links remain valid.

## Design and privacy

- [ ] The change keeps human-readable Markdown as the source of truth.
- [ ] New concepts or automation remove more complexity than they add.
- [ ] Private reference projects and user data do not appear in durable artifacts.

## Notes

Call out deliberate breaking behavior, host limitations, residual risks, and follow-up work.
